name: Week 14 Push — Volume Restored (Spotlight: Push Press + Incline DB Refresh)
description: Out of the heal week. Sets restored to normal volume across the board; loads held at W13 levels. Spotlights cycle back to push press + incline DB (per the rotation tracker) — a deep-cue refresh of the two lifts the cable column block displaced in W13. Cable column block goes to maintenance. NEW: a fresh pull-up set joins the warmup as part of the W14 pull-up greasing-the-groove plan (1-2 scattered sets across non-pull days, on top of the pull-day 4 sets).

dayOverview.theme: Volume restored, loads held. Spotlight cycles back to push press + incline DB. Cable column block goes to maintenance (no more deep cues on lat raise / tri ext / straight-arm pulldown — held at W13 calibrations). Farmer carry continues. Pull-up greasing set joins the warmup.

spotlights.why: Cycles back to spotlight per the tracker. W13D1 confirmed 45/side runs clean at the held weight (no rib flare, packed shoulders) — the W14 refresh drills the cue at the confirmed working load. The 'pack DOWN, not up' check is the spotlight question.

Cycles back to spotlight. W13D1 went to 45lb pair 'weirdly good no pain' — the 30° bench setup + forearm-stack cue clicked. W14 drills it deeper at the same load: pin the scaps, 30° not 45°, forearm vertical at the bottom.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W11 chest press · W12 lateral raise + Kinesis fly · W13 cable column block · W14 push press + incline DB (current) · W15 cycle forward — chest press or farmer carry refresh.
watchpoints: **Loads HELD at W13** — sets restored, weights stay. Push press 45, lateral raise 15, incline DB 45, chest press 165, Kinesis fly 8 (with the option to push to 9 the second time around, as W13D1 already confirmed clean).

**Right shoulder watch continues** — W13 closed without aggravation on the lifts that touched it. Cross-check vs W14D3 pull and W14D5 legs warmup. If the W12D1 cluster (line-of-sensation, grip-triggered) returns, drop volume on day; if it persists across two days, the heal-week question reopens.
**Pull-up greasing set (NEW for W14):** 1 fresh set of 6-8 in the warmup, AFTER the band warmup. Greasing the groove — bodyweight, slow, not to failure. Adds to pull-day's 4 sets.
**Pack DOWN, not up** — the cue carries across push press, incline DB, lateral raise, chest press, farmer carry. If shrug-up is required to lock out, the load is too heavy for the cue.

**Multi-equipment loads on the cable block** — see each lift's notes for the numbers per machine. The user moves around based on availability; pick the equipment that's free and log the number on that machine's scale.

sets.name: Warmup + Shoulder Rehab (Non-Negotiable) + Pull-Up Greasing Set

exercises.notes: Slow, big circles. Wake up scap glide before loading.
Full sequence with red band. Non-negotiable on push day.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain from forearm to shoulder to lats. Wakes the grip and shoulder line before loading.
Ribs down, glutes tight, body in one line. Slow eccentric, 1s pause with chest 1-2" off the floor.

**Pull-up greasing set (NEW for W14).** 1 fresh set, slow tempo, NOT to failure. Active hang start, pull elbows down to ribs, chest leads. This adds to the 4 sets on pull day — the goal is frequency, not max effort. If shoulder talks, drop to scapular-pulls only and finish the count.

**LOAD:** 45lb DBs per side. 3 sets of 8-10.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — drill every rep:**
- **Feet parallel, hip-width** — NOT duck stance
- **DBs racked on front delts**, elbows up just enough to keep them pinned
- **Ribs DOWN before the dip** — squeeze the front of the ribs toward the hips. Catch any rib flare on set 1, don't carry it.
- **Pack DOWN, not up** — shoulder blades into the back pockets, neck long. If you must shrug to lock out, the cue's broken — pause the set.
- **Shallow dip ~3-4"**, straight down through the heels
- **Vertical DB path** — DBs travel parallel up next to the ears, head pokes through at the top
- **Drive fast, lockout solid, descent controlled**
- **Breath:** in at the dip, out on the drive

**Common faults to catch:** rib flare → lumbar load; pressing head back instead of moving the head through (cue: 'look forward, walk the head through'); knees drifting forward instead of hips back on the dip.

**Reflection:** at 45 with restored 3-set volume, does set 3 still feel clean, or does the cue break? If set 3 breaks, that's the W14 ceiling — note it for W15.

sets.name: Station 2: DB Lateral Raise (3 Sets at 15)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 15lb DBs. 3 sets of 15-18.
- **Lead with elbow, hand passive** — wrist follows
- **Soft elbow ~10-15°, FIXED** through the rep
- **Stop at shoulder height — never higher**
- **2s eccentric** — slow descent is the stimulus
- Scap-reset between sets if the shoulder gets noisy

sets.name: 🔆 Station 3: Incline DB Press (Spotlight — 3 Sets at 45 pair)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45lb pair. 3 sets of 8-10.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — drill the cues that made 45 work in W13D1:**
- **Bench at 30°**, NOT 45°. Steeper = front delt, not upper chest.
- **Shoulders packed back AND down** — pin the back of the shoulder into the bench, like trying to break the bench in half with the scaps
- DBs in lap, kick up to start position one at a time
- **Forearm stacked vertically over the elbow at the bottom** — when DBs are at chest level, the elbow is directly under the wrist. This is the cue that made 45 feel honest.
- **Elbows ~45° from torso** — not flared 90°, not tucked tight
- **Press to a fingerwidth apart at the top** — no DB clack
- **Pause 1s at the bottom** — 'dead weight' before driving up
- **Breath:** in on descent, out on press

**Reflection:** at the 3-set restored volume, does the forearm stack hold automatically (the W10 cue that locked it in), or does it drift as fatigue arrives? If it drifts on set 3, drop to a 1s pause at the top to reset before set 3 ends.

sets.name: Station 4: Chest Press Machine (3 Sets at 165)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 165 (chest press machine). 3 sets of 8-10.
- **Seat height: handles align with mid-chest / nipple line** — set before sitting
- **Shoulders pinned BACK against the pad** — the foundation cue
- **3s eccentric** — count it
- **Press to almost extension** — leave a hair of bend
- Massage the right pec between sets — pre-empt the W9D1 referral pattern

**LOAD:** Kinesis 8 (working). W13D1 went to 9 fine — staying at 8 by default this week; if set 1 at 8 feels light, bump to 9 from set 2 (per the Equipment Calibration Table, 8-9 is the working range).
- **Slight forward hinge at hips** — chest leads, not head
- **Soft elbow ~10-15°, FIXED throughout**
- **'Hug a tree'** — squeeze from chest, not arms
- **Slow eccentric (~3s)** — let the cables pull the arms back for the deep pec stretch
- Stretch is the stimulus — the shoulder feels good here, protect that

sets.name: Station 6: Cable Column Block — Lat Raise → Tri Ext → Straight-Arm Pulldown (Maintenance — 3 Rounds)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:**
- **Kinesis: 5-6** (default — W9 swap, established equipment)
- **Cable column: ~30-40lb** (fallback)

3 rounds, one arm at a time.
- **Lead with elbow as a DIRECTION, not a joint action** — the elbow points, doesn't bend (W12D1 cue interaction)
- **Soft elbow ~10°, FIXED** throughout
- **Stand sideways** to the working pulley/Kinesis, working arm farther from the stack
- **Stop at shoulder height — higher = traps**
- **2s eccentric**, fight the cable on the way down

**LOAD:**
- **Cable column: 70** (default — W12D1 working number, kneeling facing away)
- **Kinesis: 5** (fallback — W13D1 confirmed 'felt pretty good')

3 rounds.
- **Kneel facing AWAY from the high pulley**, rope overhead
- **Torso slightly forward — that's the 'incline'**
- **Elbows PINNED** — only forearms move
- **Hands shoulder-width on the rope**
- **Full stretch at the bottom** — let the rope pull hands behind the head
- **Stop just shy of lockout**, slow eccentric

**LOAD:**
- **Kinesis: 6** (default — W9 swap, ≈ cable column 100)
- **Cable column: ~100** (fallback)

3 rounds.
- **Stand a step back, hinge ~15° at hips** — fixed hinge, torso doesn't pump
- **Slight elbow bend (~5°), FIXED throughout** — perfectly straight = elbow risk; bending = becomes a pulldown
- **Pull bar to the thighs, NOT past** — past = shoulders roll forward, lats switch off
- **Squeeze lats hard at the bottom** — 'oranges into the back pockets'
- **Slow controlled return to a full overhead stretch**

sets.notes: Cable block, off spotlight this week — sharp cues, 3 rounds. One trip to the chosen station covers all three. Pick the equipment that's free (Kinesis is the default on lat raise + pulldown; cable column on tri ext) and log what you used.

sets.name: Station 7: Farmer Carry (3 Walks)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 40-50lb DBs. 3 walks of ~30-45s each.
- **Stand TALL** — ribs down, crown of the head reaching up
- **Shoulders pulled DOWN and BACK** — into the back pockets, never shrugged toward the ears. The DBs will try to pull the shoulders up; resist the entire walk.
- **Neck long, eyes forward** — no chin poke
- **Walk a straight line at a deliberate pace**, breathing steadily — don't rush
- **Grip firm but not death-clenched** — W13D1 found a hard right-hand squeeze provokes the shoulder; firm-but-relaxed grip is the cue

**Watch:** does the carry continue to feel neutral on the right shoulder (like W13D1's 'grip is the hardest part'), or has it shifted? Log if the shoulder talks at any specific load.

sets.notes: Closing trap-chain block. 3 walks at 40-50lb, light load, packed-shoulder posture is the lift.

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block (Permanent Every-Gym-Day Closing Block)

exercises.notes: 30s each arm at MID elbow position. Pec minor lengthen — the antagonist to the upper-trap chain loaded all session.
Passive hang from the pull-up bar. **Don't engage** — let the shoulders unpack and the spine decompress.
30s each side on the mat. Draw one knee across the body, opposite arm extended.
45s each side. Front leg + back leg at 90°. Sink hips toward the floor — hip-rotator decompression.
60s slow breathing. Knees wide, arms extended forward. Parasympathetic shift before leaving the gym.

sets.notes: 5 minutes of recovery work, non-negotiable closing block.

tips: **Volume restored, loads held.** Sets back to 3 across the board, weights stay at W13 levels.
**Spotlight: push press + incline DB** — refreshing the two lifts the cable column block displaced in W13. Deep cues on both at the held working weights.
**Pack DOWN, not up** — push press, incline DB, lateral raise, chest press, farmer carry all carry the cue.
**Pull-up greasing set in the warmup (NEW for W14)** — 1 fresh set of 6-8, slow, not to failure. Adds to pull-day's 4 sets.
**Multi-equipment loads on the cable block** — each lift's notes list the number for Kinesis and cable column. Pick whichever's free; log the equipment + number you used.
**Farmer carry continues** — 3 walks at 40-50lb. Firm-but-relaxed grip (the W13D1 grip-clench / shoulder coupling watch).
**Right shoulder watch continues** — W13 closed clean; if the cluster returns, drop volume on day.
**Cool-down stays — 5-min block, permanent every gym day.**
Rest: 2 min push press + chest press, 90s lat raise + Kinesis fly + farmer carry, 75s cable block.
formPhilosophy: Out of the heal week — sets restored, loads held. The W14 step is volume, not weight. Push press + incline DB get the deep cue refresh because they've earned the working numbers (45/side and 45lb pair both ran clean W13D1). The cable block holds its cues. Building decades, not weeks.
